content.description:
FILED BY WAVE 15 AS LEAD-OWNED DEBT (charter D242; D170(c) reserves this to the lead). Measured on a real merge of PR #10129 into today origin/main.

THE CONFLICT SET IS SIX PATHS, stable across ~11 hours of main movement: cloud/priv/static/__fixtures__/attention_order.json, internal/cli/cloud_status_cmd.go, internal/cli/cloud_status_cmd_test.go, internal/cli/testdata/attention_order_cases.json, internal/cloudclient/client.go, internal/semrole/semrole.go. Two of those are TRUE UNIONS and were proved mechanical by building them (semrole case-arm union and the client.go struct-tail append both build clean, and go test ./internal/semrole/ is ok). The other four are not.

THE LADDER IS A DELETION, NOT AN INSERTION. main ships ELEVEN rungs (D69, c2eecb66d / #9887, landed AFTER #10129 was cut) and #10129 ships TEN that structurally REMOVE strained (rank 5), filling (6) and unreported (7) along with unreported deliberate evaluation-order-not-rank-order exemption. Proof that the Go arm does not rebase: taking main side on the three ladder files leaves go build ./... clean and go test ./internal/cli/ ok in 24.6s with ZERO occurrences of deploys_failing. There is nothing left of the feature.

THREE DECISIONS NO DIFF CAN MAKE. (1) Where deploys_failing sits relative to strained/filling/unreported — neither side rationale considered the other rungs and both claim rank 5. (2) Where unmetered sits — the PR puts it at 9, BELOW provisioning, yet in bucket attention. (3) unmetered tone is the empty string on the PR, and main landed a tone-hole guard AFTER 10129 base (cloud_status_cmd_test.go:404: "fixture tone must be a real semantic role, not empty — an uncoloured status ships invisible"), so the PR fixture row is ILLEGAL on main independent of rank.

WHAT WAVE 15 TOOK AND WHAT IT LEFT. The Elixir half — @agency plus its enum-keyed exhaustiveness assertion — is the only part that survives a rebase intact, and wave 15 MINTS it itself in dr-w15-s2 rather than stacking (D242). So this task is now purely the ladder decision plus a re-cut of the Go arm, or a close.

TWO THINGS THE MERGE ALSO REVEALED. #10129 raises barkpark_json from arity 4 to arity 5, which trips PayloadKeySetCensusTest with SEVEN reds whose anti-vacuity floor fires "only 47 emitted key(s) collected, floor is 103 — the EXTRACTOR is broken, not the payload shrunk". The correct fix is bumping the census pin to arity 5; DO NOT lower the floor. And both semrole comment rationales argue from rank numbers that are all false after any merge.
